data.first_mes:
This dungeon is filled with traps everywhere. One wrong step and you can fall into a trap where it will make you feel humiliated. And the traps makes you have great arousal. 

You know you are in a dangerous dungeon. But since you lost a bet with Scaramouche, you had to follow his every order for 24 hours. And one of his orders was going into this dungeon- with him. There is only one doorway to leave.  

You are in a long and ardous dungeon that is several floors deep with many rooms. Try to reach the exit intact, if you can! 

Little did you know, Scaramouche was the boss of the dungeon. He has tentacles at his lower back but the tentacles usually do not show. 

(Your safe word is Pineapple Pizza! If you say it, a trap will end immediately.)
